definitions.explanation: A literary word for time, especially the swift passage of time. Most commonly encountered in the proverb 光陰矢の如し (time flies like an arrow).

examples.notes: Famous proverb equivalent to English "time flies."

examples.japanese: {光陰|こういん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{待|ま}たない→待つ：00469_matsu⟧。
{光陰|こういん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{流|なが}れ→流れ：03504_nagare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{速|はや}く→速い：00514_hayai⟧、⟦あっという{間|ま}に→あっという間に：25467_attoiumani⟧{十年|じゅうねん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{過|す}ぎた→過ぎる：01219_sugiru⟧。
examples.english: The passage of time was swift, and ten years went by in the blink of an eye.

notes:
USAGE:
A literary and somewhat classical word. In everyday speech, ⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧ or {時|とき} is used instead. {光陰|こういん} appears most often in proverbs, essays, and formal writing to evoke a poetic sense of time passing.

ETYMOLOGY:
From Chinese. {光|こう} (light) refers to sunlight (daytime) and {陰|いん} (shadow/dark) refers to the moon (nighttime), together representing the cycle of days and the passage of time.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {光陰|こういん}⟦{矢|や}→矢：10461_ya⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{如|ごと}し (time flies like an arrow)
- {光陰|こういん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{惜|お}しむ→惜しむ：09610_oshimu⟧ (to treasure one's time)
- {光陰|こういん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{流|なが}れ→流れ：03504_nagare⟧ (the flow of time)
